::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Hyderabad power-management IC startup with links to IIT Hyderabad (IITH faculty advisers, IITH-alumni staff). Leadership: Prakash Easwaran (CEO), Sumit Bhat (CTO), R Sai Chandra Teja (COO). No tape-out publicly reported yet.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Multi-input energy-harvesting power-management ICs that let IoT devices run without batteries.
